{"people":[{"name":"Dana","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Ines","role":"CFO, about four months in; final decider and signer","side":"customer"},{"name":"Paul","role":"IT director, day-to-day contact; recommends but does not decide","side":"customer"},{"name":"Wen","role":"Solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Controller","role":"Sent one month of statements (unnamed)","side":"customer"},{"name":"Bank representative","role":"Customer's bank contact; source of Fiserv incumbent relationship (unnamed)","side":"other"}],
 "competitors":["Fiserv"],
 "incumbent":"Fiserv, through the customer's bank",
 "evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"I thought it was the online ordering portal.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's initial read; later says the portal was not the real trigger."},
{"id":"E2","turn":4,"excerpt":"The portal was the excuse.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's reframing; the real trigger was the month-end close."},
{"id":"E3","turn":4,"excerpt":"they had a new CFO. Ines.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"New CFO, about four months in; rep found her around the third call."},
{"id":"E4","turn":4,"excerpt":"her first month-end close took nine days.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Nine-day close in the CFO's first month is the stated pain."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"month-end is a week of archaeology.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own pain framing; rep wrote it down verbatim."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"two people in finance matching deposits from the bank against the processor statements against invoices in the ERP.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Manual spreadsheet reconciliation; the problem is process, not the portal."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"I can recommend, she decides.","label":"quote","speaker":"Paul (IT director, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Paul says Ines is the final decider, not him."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"she's the one who signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Ines signed the contract."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"She's also the one who sat on the first proposal.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's characterization of the stall after the first proposal."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"Paul had forwarded it to her, she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Unquoted report of CFO's reaction to the portal-focused proposal."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"nothing happened for three weeks.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Stall followed the first proposal, which was about the portal."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"Fiserv was the incumbent, through their bank.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent relationship runs through the customer's bank."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"I never saw a deck.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep has no direct view of what Fiserv pitched."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"we can take a look at your rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bank representative (relayed by Ines)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Bank's response to the switch inquiry, relayed secondhand."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"I didn't ask about my rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"CFO's reaction; she was not asking about rates."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"If anything she got more annoyed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's unverified read on CFO's mood after the bank call."},
{"id":"E17","turn":12,"excerpt":"whether she'd get a named contact.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Unquoted post-bank question; her bank contact had changed."},
{"id":"E18","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence was the whole opening.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Standard first-call deck drew no reaction."},
{"id":"E19","turn":14,"excerpt":"Financial infrastructure, global growth, all the currencies.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our standard deck framing; it got silence."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"They sell to restaurants in three states.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Regional restaurant-supply business context."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"Ines wasn't on that call, thank god.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The final decider was absent from the first deck."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"Paul's team is four people and they aren't building anything.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Conflicts with rep's earlier framing that they were building a portal."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"The portal is off the shelf with a plugin.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's claim that the portal is not a build project."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"go back.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"CFO stopped the first demo and redirected to the reconciliation."},
{"id":"E25","turn":14,"excerpt":"Then she asked if she could see it with their data.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Request to see the product on their own data; turning point."},
{"id":"E26","turn":14,"excerpt":"The reaction was the payout reconciliation.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Payout-to-transaction reconciliation is what drew engagement."},
{"id":"E27","turn":16,"excerpt":"the controller sent them over","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Customer shared one month of statements for analysis."},
{"id":"E28","turn":16,"excerpt":"It was something like 60 hours a month across two people.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Hedged estimate of matching hours, not a confirmed figure."},
{"id":"E29","turn":16,"excerpt":"Low six figures a year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's uncertain dollar estimate, built from customer cost data."},
{"id":"E30","turn":16,"excerpt":"that's my number, not yours.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","message"],"note":"CFO accepted the ROI because it used her own data."},
{"id":"E31","turn":16,"excerpt":"I don't remember the exact figure.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep lacks the exact ROI figure despite citing specifics earlier."},
{"id":"E32","turn":18,"excerpt":"I had it at 20 percent.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's pre-ROI-meeting estimate; rep also called the deal dead."},
{"id":"E33","turn":20,"excerpt":"She wanted to talk to another distributor.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Reference request from a wholesale distribution buyer."},
{"id":"E34","turn":20,"excerpt":"this is a company that sells sweaters.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"Retail case study judged irrelevant to wholesale buyer."},
{"id":"E35","turn":20,"excerpt":"We never got her a call.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Requested reference call was never delivered."},
{"id":"E36","turn":20,"excerpt":"She signed anyway, but she brought it up twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","gaps"],"note":"Signed despite the unresolved reference gap."},
{"id":"E37","turn":20,"excerpt":"They have 14 branches with counter sales","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Counter-sales scope was raised; unclear whether it was in the signed deal."},
{"id":"E38","turn":20,"excerpt":"Wen said yes and showed a slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Card-reader reporting was answered with a slide, not a demo."},
{"id":"E39","turn":22,"excerpt":"A week of archaeology","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's own pain phrase; the one she used most."},
{"id":"E40","turn":22,"excerpt":"I just want to know where my money is.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Her stated goal, in plain money terms."},
{"id":"E41","turn":22,"excerpt":"the deposits.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"CFO's term for payments; she never said payments."},
{"id":"E42","turn":22,"excerpt":"the processor.","label":"quote","speaker":"Paul (IT director, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Paul's term for the payments provider."},
{"id":"E43","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody said \"infrastructure.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our infrastructure framing did not appear in customer speech."},
{"id":"E44","turn":22,"excerpt":"She never once said \"payments.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer avoided our core category word."},
{"id":"E45","turn":24,"excerpt":"Find the CFO sooner.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Dana (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's retrospective lesson on reaching the decider."}
],
 "contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E1","E22"],"what":"Rep first said the customer was building a portal, then says Paul's team builds nothing and the portal is off the shelf."},
{"evidence":["E28","E31"],"what":"Rep cites specific hours and a 'low six figures' figure from the controller session, then says they don't remember the exact figure. ROI basis is unclear."}
],
 "dodges":[
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":9,"what":"Answered 'I honestly don't know what Fiserv showed them, if anything'; no content on the competitor pitch."},
{"question":"What changed in their questions after they'd talked to the bank?","turn":11,"what":"Answered 'Not much', then gave one unrelated question about a named contact."},
{"question":"What did they ask for that we couldn't show?","turn":19,"what":"Card-reader reporting question answered with 'Wen said yes and showed a slide' rather than a demo."}
],
 "skipped":[],
 "language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the online ordering portal","ours":"checkout","evidence":["E1"]},
{"theirs":"month-end is a week of archaeology / A week of archaeology","ours":"payout reconciliation","evidence":["E5","E26"]},
{"theirs":"I just want to know where my money is.","ours":"Financial infrastructure, global growth, all the currencies.","evidence":["E40","E19"]},
{"theirs":"the deposits / the processor","ours":"payments","evidence":["E41","E42","E44"]},
{"theirs":"another distributor","ours":"retail case study","evidence":["E33","E34"]}
],
 "outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E8","E36"],"what":"Won. Ines signed, but the reference gap was never closed."},
{"evidence":["E32"],"what":"Rep put it at 20 percent and 'Dead' before the ROI meeting; 'After that it was paperwork' followed."},
{"evidence":["E36","E37","E38"],"what":"Signed, but whether counter-sales card readers (14 branches) were in scope is not confirmed; they were not demoed."}
]}
